## How I checked it

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test:native` passes (if `native/` changed)
- [ ] A note in `changes/` (if a user would notice it)
- [ ] Measured cost reported (if capture, VAD or a background process changed)
- [ ] No real audio, transcript, voice data or names of real people
- [ ] I have read [CLA.md](https://github.com/Synapsr/sondine/blob/main/CLA.md) and I agree to it (every other author says so in a comment)
